blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Procrustes–Wasserstein alignment jointly estimates a matching and rotation without supplied correspondences, but alternating minimization can stop at suboptimal solutions. Rubix solves the equally weighted planar problem globally under squared Euclidean loss. Each matching σ \sigma of two centered n n -point sets defines a complex correlation z σ = ∑ i x ¯ i ​ y σ ⁡ ( i ) z_{\sigma}=\sum_{i}\bar{x}_{i}y_{\sigma(i)} . Their convex hull is the permutation polygon: supporting vertices give optimal matchings at fixed rotations, and the farthest vertex gives the global alignment. We prove the sharp bound of n ⁡ ( n − 1 ) n(n-1) vertices for n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 , answering Rote’s rotation–assignment open problem. In exact arithmetic, assignment queries recover the polygon in 𝒪 ⁡ ( n 5 ) \mathcal{O}(n^{5}) operations. Assignment-based bounds extend the approach to three-dimensional rotations and partial matching at a supplied translation through branch-and-bound. On timed MPEG-7 shape pairs, Rubix attains every numerical reference value in 12 ms on average, 50 times faster than a rotation grid at the same accuracy. Its distances improve shape retrieval and noisy crystal classification over alternating minimization.

blocks.en: Shape retrieval [ 37 ] , landmark registration [ 79 ] , laser-scan mapping [ 20 , 35 ] and crystal identification [ 36 ] require comparing point sets with unknown correspondences. Procrustes–Wasserstein (PW) alignment jointly optimizes a transformation and a transport coupling [ 5 , 2 ] . Here, correspondence-free means that no correspondences are supplied: Rubix optimizes them internally. We begin with equally sized, uniformly weighted planar sets and squared Euclidean loss, so an optimal coupling can be chosen as a bijection. Centering removes translation, and nonnegative isotropic scale has a closed-form fit.
blocks.zh: 形状检索[37],地标登记[79],激光扫描绘图[20,35]和晶体识别[36]需要将点集与未知的函证进行比较. Procrustes – Wasserstein (PW) 组合联合优化了变换和运合[5,2]. 这里,无通信意味着不提供通信: Rubix在内部优化了它们. 我们以同样大小的,统一的加权平板机和平方的欧几利得损失为起点,因此可以选择一个最佳的接合物作为活字. 居中可以去除翻译,而非负异构尺度具有闭合形式相合.

blocks.en: The matching and rotation are coupled unknowns. Fixing the rotation gives a linear assignment problem; fixing the matching gives a closed-form orthogonal fit [ 67 ] . Alternating minimization (AM) [ 2 ] can stop at a suboptimal fixed point and change retrieval rankings. Branch-and-bound [ 40 , 29 ] gives global guarantees, but bounds that allow each residual its own rotation can require extensive subdivision. Zikan’s exact rotation sweep [ 79 ] showed roughly quadratic growth in network pivots experimentally, without a polynomial worst-case bound. Rote’s rotation–assignment problem [ 55 ] asks whether polynomially many matchings contain an optimum for every rotation. General affine parametric assignment can require superpolynomially many [ 15 , 31 ] ; a polynomial bound must exploit rotation structure.
blocks.zh: 相配和旋转是相配的未知数. 修整旋转会给线性分配带来问题;修整匹配会给封闭式正交配 [67]. 替代最小化 (AM) [2] 可以在一个次优的固定点上停下来并改变回取的排名. 分会和分会[40,29]提供全球保障,但允许每个剩余部分自行轮换的界限需要广泛的分会. Zikan的精确旋转扫荡[79]在试验中显示网络平面呈大约四相增长,没有多重最坏情况的约束。 Rote的轮换-分配问题[55]询问许多匹配是否包含每个轮换的最佳条件。 一般的近缘参数指派可能要求超相多[15,31];多相结合必须利用自转结构.

blocks.en: Rubix represents each matching by its complex correlation ( Figure 2 ). Rotation changes only the projection direction of these fixed correlations. Their convex hull, the permutation polygon , therefore suffices for alignment: a supporting vertex gives an optimal matching at each rotation, and the farthest vertex gives the global alignment. Lexicographic assignment queries recover supporting vertices without enumerating matchings. Our sharp quadratic vertex bound makes full reconstruction polynomial. The same geometry explains AM: under our assignment initialization and tie rules, a nonzero initial vertex leads to a stationary vertex, which need not be farthest from the origin.
blocks.zh: Rubix以其复杂的关联性(图2)代表每个匹配. 旋转只改变这些固定关联的预测方向. 因此,它们的对流船体 -- -- 通直多边形 -- -- 足以对齐:一个支撑顶点在每次旋转时都提供最佳对齐,最远的顶点则提供全球对齐。 地理学任务查询恢复支持的顶点而不列出匹配. 我们尖锐的四面体顶点连接 使整个重建变得多元 同样的几何学解释AM:在我们的任务初始化和平分规则下,一个非零初始顶点会导致一个固定顶点,而这个顶点不需要远离起源地.

blocks.en: For partial and three-dimensional alignment, assignment queries instead bound regions of pose space for branch-and-bound. Queries at the vertices of an enclosure evaluate all matched pairs at a common pose parameter, retaining information lost by independent residual bounds; each returned matching also gives a feasible alignment. Known gravity reduces rotation to yaw; general rotations use unit-quaternion regions. Partial matching requires either a supplied translation or joint pose search. We also adapt the common-translation bound to GLORES’s trimmed registration objective [ 20 ] , preserving its objective and stopping rule. The guarantees concern matching cost; pose accuracy is evaluated separately.
blocks.zh: 就局部和三维对齐而言,任务查询是限制分行和分行空间的区域。 在一个附文的顶点进行查询,在常见的外观参数下评价所有匹配的对子,保留被独立剩余边框所丢失的信息;每个返回的匹配还给出了可行的对齐. 已知的重力会减少自转至 ya;一般自转使用单位-quaternion区域. 部分匹配需要提供翻译或联合定位搜索。 我们还根据GLORES的裁缝登记目标调整共同译名, 担保涉及匹配费用;表态准确性另行评估。

blocks.en: (i) We prove the sharp n ⁡ ( n − 1 ) n(n-1) vertex bound, including ties and repeated points, answering Rote’s question [ 55 ] ( Section 5 ). (ii) Rubix solves planar alignment exactly in 𝒪 ⁡ ( n 5 ) \mathcal{O}(n^{5}) arithmetic operations, with at most 2 ​ n ​ ( n − 1 ) 2n(n-1) assignment queries for rotations or 4 ​ n ​ ( n − 1 ) 4n(n-1) with reflections, and characterizes AM fixed points ( Section 6 ). (iii) Returned matchings and assignment duals verify global optimality exactly for rational inputs ( Proposition 11 ). (iv) For gravity-aligned, partial and full 3D alignment, we derive pose-region bounds, accuracy-dependent query counts and reusable certificates; the coupled yaw bound is second order, versus first order for per-correspondence and independent-edge bounds ( Section 7 ). (v) Experiments test the distances in retrieval, crystal classification and clustering, partial matching under incomplete overlap, and the bounds inside planar and spatial registration solvers ( Section 8 ). Full proofs, search algorithms and experimental details appear in the appendices.
blocks.zh: (一) 我们证明尖锐的n(n− 1)n(n−1)顶点绑定,包括领带和反复点数,回答罗特的问题[55](第5节). (二) Rubix解决了精确在O−(n 5)\ mathcal{O}(n−5})算术操作中的平面对齐,最多2n(n− 1)2n(n−1)对旋转的指派查询或4n(n− 1)4n(n−1)4(n−1)带有反射,并定性AM固定点(第6节)。 (三) 返回的匹配和派任双重核查全球最佳性,完全用于合理投入(提议11)。 (四)对于重力对接,局部和完全三维对接,我们得出平面区域界限,精度依赖的查询计数和可再用证书;相接的yaw对接是第二顺序,相对于每对接和独立对接界限的第一顺序(第7节). (五)实验测试取回距离,晶体分类和集群,不完整重叠下部分相配,以及平面和空间登记解析器内的界限(第八节. 完整的证明,搜索算法和实验细节出现在附录中.

blocks.en: Alvarez-Melis et al. [ 5 ] formulate transport under global invariances; Grave et al. [ 28 ] combine convex initialization with stochastic updates; Even et al. [ 25 ] analyze Ping-Pong in a planted Gaussian model; and Adamo et al. [ 2 ] study PW metrics and barycenters. Semidefinite relaxations recover noiseless isometric shapes that are asymmetric or bilaterally symmetric [ 54 ] and certify planar landmark localization when tight, usually at moderate noise [ 34 ] . SEINT [ 52 ] compares SE( d d )-invariant transport features without alignment. Rubix gives an exact polynomial algorithm for equal-weight planar PW with squared loss.

blocks.en: Zikan [ 79 ] sweeps rotations with unknown bijections, translation and optional scale, without a polynomial worst-case bound. Utriainen [ 73 ] studies vector-weighted matching, approximation and global optimization. Polynomial enumeration for supplied pairs covers consensus with pseudoconvex residuals [ 56 ] and planar similarity with ℓ 1 \ell_{1} or truncated losses [ 6 ] ; our bound concerns squared-error bijections with unknown correspondences.

blocks.en: The permutation polygon is the classical c c -eigenpolygon of a diagonal matrix [ 53 , 39 ] . We extend the real-weight permutohedron bound of n ⁡ ( n − 1 ) n(n-1) vertices [ 78 , 31 ] to complex weights, ties and repeated points. This makes Eisner–Severance enumeration [ 24 ] polynomial for planar rotation scores, despite superpolynomial general parametric assignments [ 15 , 31 ] . Polynomial enumeration of optimal partial matchings under translation remains open [ 8 ] . Soubrier et al. [ 70 ] also project transport plans into covariance space, obtaining concave multilinear approximations of Gromov–Wasserstein (GW) distances in fixed dimension with bounded support and uniformly positive definite second moments; our PW reconstruction is exact.
blocks.zh: 通向多边形为一对角矩阵的古典 c c-eigenpolygon [53,39]. 我们把实际重量的正方形(n-1)n(n-1)n(n-1)顶点[78,31]延伸至复杂的重量,领带和重复点. 这使得Eisner–Severance为平面旋转计分而计分[24]多诺米,尽管超波形一般参数化任务[15,31]. 翻译下最优部分匹配的多诺分数仍然开放 [8]. Soubrier等 (中文(简体) ). [70] 还将运输计划投放到共变空间,在固定的维度上获得Gromov-Wasserstein(GW)距离的相接多线性近似值,并有固定的支持和一致的肯定的第二时刻;我们的PW重建是准确的。

blocks.en: Li–Hartley [ 40 ] bound centered equal-size registration by assignments and per-point residual changes. Related searches cover rotation space [ 29 ] , geometric matching [ 9 ] , and camera pose with unknown correspondences [ 14 ] . Lian–Zhang [ 47 ] eliminate transformations and bound a concave correspondence objective by cardinality-constrained assignment. APM [ 46 ] uses a low-rank concave quadratic when every source point has a counterpart; RPM-PA [ 48 ] uses polyhedral annexation. Later bounds use trilinear and bilinear relaxations [ 49 ] , assignment with convex quadratics [ 44 ] , or transformation-box vertices [ 45 ] . Rubix combines covariance geometry, quaternion fitting [ 30 ] , rotation orbitopes [ 64 , 65 ] and positive-weight rational Bézier enclosures [ 59 ] . Its spatial searches terminate at positive tolerance without inheriting the planar polynomial bound.
blocks.zh: Li-Hartley [40] 绑定以任务和每个点的剩余变化等大小的注册为中心. 相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 Lian–Zhang [47] 取消变相,并以受重任约束的指派方式约束了集合函授目标. APM [46] 在每个源点有对应点时使用低等同位素四相; RPM-PA [48] 使用多相并吞. 后期边界使用三线和双线松动[49],以对流四极管进行分配[44],或变形-盒式顶点[45]. Rubix结合了共相几何,四相配 [30],自转轨道 [64,65] 和正重理性 贝塞尔附文 [59]. 其空间搜索以正相能耐而终止,而不会继承平面多诺分界.

blocks.en: GLORES [ 20 ] searches trimmed SE(2) registration globally; PLICP [ 16 ] alternates exact point-to-line updates for fixed pairs. Both allow repeated target use. Known gravity enables constrained point-to-plane ICP [ 35 ] , pair pruning followed by translation search with optimal yaw [ 13 ] , and cylindrical-norm registration [ 1 ] . Li et al. [ 42 , 43 ] develop deterministic decompositions and consensus searches, including correspondence-free translation from angles to gravity [ 42 ] and subsequent gravity-based outlier rejection [ 41 ] . Quatro [ 51 ] reduces TEASER++ [ 75 ] to yaw; Quatro++ [ 50 ] adds ground segmentation and tilt compensation. OptiPose [ 33 ] minimizes truncated least squares over supplied pairs about a fixed axis. Our comparisons distinguish these objectives and input requirements.
blocks.zh: GLORES [20] 搜索被修剪的SE(2)全球注册; PLICP [16] 替换对固定对接的精确点对线更新. 两者都允许重复使用目标. 已知的重力使得受限点对飞机的比较方案[35],对接后用最优的yaw[13]进行翻译搜索,并进行圆柱-规范登记[1]。 李等编. [42,43] 开发确定分解和共识搜索,包括从角度到重力的无函文翻译 [42] 以及随后基于重力的外部拒绝 [41]. Quatro [51]将TEASER++ [75] 减少为 yaw; Quatro++ [50] 增加地段分和倾斜补偿. OptiPose [33] 将所供应的一对关于一固定轴的最小平方最小减到最小. 我们的比较区分了这些目标和投入要求。

blocks.en: Trimmed ICP [ 18 ] selects nearest-neighbor residuals; partial transport [ 60 ] controls matched mass. GW compares internal relations, with global methods for low-dimensional Euclidean instances [ 63 ] . Unbalanced GW [ 68 ] relaxes marginal conservation, partial GW [ 17 ] fixes transported mass, and fused unbalanced GW [ 72 ] adds feature costs. These nonconvex coupling objectives differ from our rigid fit with a total-variation penalty on unmatched mass ( Remark 16 ). Cost-regularized unbalanced transport [ 58 ] jointly optimizes couplings and bounded-norm inner-product costs, guaranteeing stationary points.
blocks.zh: Trimmed ICP [18] 选择最近的邻接残基; 部分运输 [60] 控制与质量相匹配. GW比较了内部关系,与低维Euclide例的全球方法[63]. 不平衡的GW [68] 放松了边际保护,部分GW [17] 修补了被运输的质量,并熔接了不平衡的GW [72] 增加了特征成本. 这些非对接目标不同于我们硬性规定的对未匹配质量的完全变异性处罚(第16段)。 成本规范化不平衡运输[58]联合优化搭配和定界-规范内产成本,保障定点.

blocks.en: Generalized-CVO [ 77 ] locally optimizes kernel correlation on SE(3); Register Any Point (RAP) [ 57 ] learns registration by flow matching. PREDATOR [ 32 ] learns overlap attention, and GeoTransformer [ 61 ] matches superpoints through learned geometry. Coordinate-only Rubix can refine these systems. We report complete systems for context and isolate matching through a common stage after Quatro, RAP and Li et al., with fixed subsets, initialization and outer processing ( Section 8.4.2 ).

blocks.en: 4 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 4 问题提出

blocks.en: At a fixed rotation, the best matching is the solution of a linear assignment problem. This section shows that the rotation enters this problem only as a direction of projection. We encode each matching by one complex number, its correlation ; a rotation then selects a projection of the correlations, and the joint optimum over rotations and matchings is a farthest point of their convex hull.

blocks.en: The proof follows one real quantity, the phase of the optimal matching, as the supporting direction turns. The phase is the sum, over all pairs of rows, of the angle of the swap gain of the pair, the amount by which the correlation of the matching exceeds that of the matching with the two partners swapped ( Section 5.2 ). While one matching stays optimal the phase decreases at a fixed rate, and each change of the optimal matching increases it by at least π \pi . Over a full turn the phase returns to its initial value, so the jumps must restore a total decrease of π ​ n ​ ( n − 1 ) \pi n(n-1) , which allows at most n ⁡ ( n − 1 ) n(n-1) changes. We first work with generic ( a , b ) (a,b) , for which the correlations of distinct matchings are distinct and no three of them are collinear, so that each transition involves exactly two matchings. Generic pairs are dense and have full measure ( Lemmas A.2 and A.2.1 ), and a perturbation argument then extends the bound to all inputs. Section A.7.1 gives the complete proof of Theorem 2 .

Under genericity, a supporting line contains at most two correlations, so at most two matchings are optimal in any direction. If two are optimal, switching any single cycle of their difference leaves the projection unchanged: the cycles act on disjoint rows, so their changes of the projection add up to zero, and none of them is positive. Two nontrivial cycles would therefore produce a third optimal matching, a contradiction. The full proof is in Section A.3 .
∎

blocks.en: Two geometric properties of Γ e \Gamma_{e} determine the phase jump at e e . First, an optimal dual solution of the assignment problem at the transition defines a power diagram [ 7 ] on the points b j b_{j} , and two points can exchange partners at the transition only if their cells are neighbors. The segments that join neighboring cells do not cross, so a cycle of length at least three forms a simple polygon. Second, traversing 𝒫 \mathcal{P} counterclockwise fixes the orientation of the cycle, which is also counterclockwise. Both properties are proved in Sections A.5 and A.6 .

The power-diagram construction makes Γ e \Gamma_{e} simple and counterclockwise, with no off-cycle point on its boundary. For arbitrary inputs, a polygon that is a single point satisfies the bound directly; otherwise Lemma 6 gives a nearby generic polygon with at least as many vertices, which extends the bound to every input. The statement about matchings holds because one representative matching per vertex contains an optimal matching for every direction ( Section 4.2 ), and under genericity only the two adjacent vertices tie at an edge normal. blocks.en: Theorem 2 answers Rote’s question [ 55 ] . It counts representative matchings and not all optimal ones: when all points coincide, all n ! n! matchings are optimal, but one representative suffices. For generic inputs, the counting identity shows that equality holds exactly when every transition swaps two points. For generic inputs with n = 3 n=3 , the number of vertices is six minus the number of transitions that are 3 3 -cycles.
blocks.zh: 定理2 答案 罗特的问题 [55]. 它算的是代表性匹配,而不是所有的最佳匹配: 当所有点都一致时, 所有n! n! 匹配是最佳的,但有一个代表就够了。 就一般投入而言,计算身份表明,平等恰恰在每次过渡时交换出两点时存在。 对于以n=3n=3为单位的通用输入,顶点数为6减去3个周期的过渡数.

blocks.en: Because Theorem 2 permits repeated points, replacing each weighted point by copies of equal mass extends the vertex bound to transport with rational weights and to uniformly weighted sets of different sizes.

blocks.en: 6 The Rubix Algorithm
blocks.zh: 6 鲁比克算法

blocks.en: Rubix reconstructs the permutation polygon by assignment queries, selects a farthest vertex, and recovers the optimal matching and rotation through Lemma 1 . Each query either discovers a new vertex or confirms an edge between two known vertices, so the number of queries is proportional to the number of vertices.
blocks.zh: Rubix通过任务查询来重建通程多边形,选择最远的顶点,并通过Lemma 1 来恢复最佳匹配和旋转. 每个查询要么发现一个新的顶点,要么确认两个已知顶点之间的边缘,因此查询次数与顶点数成正比.

blocks.en: The algorithm reaches the polygon through an assignment oracle . For a nonzero direction u u , Oracle ⁡ ( u ) \mathrm{Oracle}(u) returns a correlation that maximizes Re ⁡ ( u ¯ ​ z ) \operatorname{Re}(\bar{u}z) and, among these maximizers, one that maximizes the secondary projection Re ⁡ ( i ​ u ¯ ​ z ) \operatorname{Re}(\overline{\mathrm{i}u}z) . The primary maximizers form the supporting face in direction u u , and the secondary projection selects an endpoint of this face. The oracle therefore always returns a vertex, also when u u is normal to an edge and when several matchings share a correlation. A cubic-time assignment solver implements this lexicographic order by working with pairs of costs that are compared lexicographically and added componentwise. Around the oracle, we use the enumeration scheme of Eisner and Severance [ 24 ] .

For such a chord, it queries the outward normal direction u = − i ⁡ ( z ′ − z ) u=-\mathrm{i}(z^{\prime}-z) and obtains a vertex z ′′ z^{\prime\prime} . The support gap h 𝒫 ​ ( u ) − Re ⁡ ( u ¯ ​ z ) = Re ⁡ ( u ¯ ​ ( z ′′ − z ) ) h_{\mathcal{P}}(u)-\operatorname{Re}(\bar{u}z)=\operatorname{Re}(\bar{u}(z^{\prime\prime}-z)) is positive precisely when z ′′ z^{\prime\prime} lies beyond the chord, in which case the arc is split at z ′′ z^{\prime\prime} . blocks.en: The reconstructed hull can be verified independently of the solver that produced it. For inputs with rational coordinates, the query directions u = − i ⁡ ( z ′ − z ) u=-\mathrm{i}(z^{\prime}-z) are rational without normalization, so all assignment scores are rational. A dual solution ( f , g ) (f,g) of an assignment problem is feasible if f i + g j ≥ c i ​ j f_{i}+g_{j}\geq c_{ij} for all i , j i,j , and it then bounds the score of every matching by ∑ i f i + ∑ j g j \sum_{i}f_{i}+\sum_{j}g_{j} . If a returned matching attains this bound, its support value is verified. Checking the outward normal direction of every boundary edge in this way rules out correlations beyond the reconstructed hull.

blocks.en: Comparing squared moduli avoids square roots during the maximization; the squared PW value is c − 2 ​ r ⋆ / n c-2r_{\star}/n , where c = ( ‖ x ‖ 2 + ‖ y ‖ 2 ) / n c=(\|x\|^{2}+\|y\|^{2})/n and r ⋆ ≥ 0 r_{\star}\geq 0 is the maximum modulus. In floating point, comparisons can merge nearby vertices, so the double-precision values that serve as references in our experiments are numerical and are not certificates.

When only the alignment is needed, most of the polygon need not be reconstructed. We skip an unexplored arc if an upper bound on the modulus over the arc shows that it cannot improve on the best vertex found so far. The bound uses the directions in which the two endpoints of the arc were found. When these directions span a counterclockwise angle in ( 0 , π ) (0,\pi) , the arc lies in the triangle formed by its endpoints and the intersection of their supporting lines; if one endpoint lies on the supporting line of the other, the arc lies on the chord. Since the modulus is convex, it is bounded on the arc by its largest value at the corners. The two initial queries use opposite directions, for which this bound is not available. We refine an arc whenever its bound is unavailable or permits an improvement. With exact comparisons, pruning preserves the optimum and the worst-case query bound, although it may return only part of the polygon.

blocks.en: 6.3 Comparison with AM
blocks.zh: 6.3 与AM的比较

blocks.en: The polygon also describes the behavior of AM [ 2 ] . From a matching with nonzero correlation z z , AM fits the rotation and then solves an assignment problem, which is a support query in the radial direction z / | z | z/|z| . We call a nonzero vertex z z stationary if Re ⁡ ( z ¯ ​ ( w − z ) ) ≤ 0 \operatorname{Re}(\bar{z}(w-z))\leq 0 for all w ∈ 𝒫 w\in\mathcal{P} , that is, if its radial direction supports the polygon at z z ; this is the first-order condition for maximizing | z | |z| . A fixed point of AM is a state whose matching and rotation are unchanged by a full update. A stationary vertex is a fixed point when the assignment step keeps the current matching whenever it is optimal; other tie-breaking rules can select another maximizer. Stationary vertices need not be farthest from the origin, which is how AM stops at suboptimal alignments ( Figure 2 ).

AM的固定点是一个状态,其匹配和旋转通过全面更新而保持不变. 固定顶点是指派步骤在最理想时保持当前匹配时的固定点;其他打结规则可以选择另一个最大化点. 站台顶点不需要离发源地最远,这就是AM如何以次优对接而止(图2).

blocks.en: For SO ⁡ ( 2 ) \mathrm{SO}(2) , the correlation moduli produced by AM [ 2 ] never decrease. Suppose that AM is initialized by an assignment step and that each assignment step returns a vertex and keeps the current matching when it is optimal. Then every matching that AM visits has a vertex correlation, and such a matching with nonzero correlation is a fixed point exactly when its vertex is stationary. Starting from a nonzero vertex correlation, these updates reach a fixed matching after at most V − 1 V-1 matching changes, with V − 1 ≤ n ⁡ ( n − 1 ) − 1 V-1\leq n(n-1)-1 for n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 . A farthest vertex is globally optimal. At zero correlation, any rotation is a valid update, and if 𝒫 = { 0 } \mathcal{P}=\{0\} , all rotations are globally optimal.

blocks.en: The planar bound of n ⁡ ( n − 1 ) n(n-1) vertices has no known analogue for three-dimensional or partial alignment, so there we bound regions of pose space directly and search them by branch-and-bound. In each region, or cell , a few assignment queries at shared directions bound the residual of every matching from below, and fitting the returned matchings gives feasible poses. We discard the cells that cannot improve on the incumbent and tighten or subdivide the rest. With a known gravity direction, the bound comes from the concavity of the smallest residual in suitable yaw coordinates. For unrestricted rotations, it comes from the convexity of the largest correlation score in a lifted quaternion variable, which bounds the score from above and hence the residual from below.

blocks.en: The constructions differ in the pose variables that remain to be searched ( Table 1 ). A known gravity direction leaves only the yaw ( Figure 4 ), whereas unrestricted rotation requires cells of unit quaternions. Complete matching removes the translation by centering, whereas partial matching keeps it as a supplied quantity or as a further search variable. Throughout, we minimize the sum of squared distances over one-to-one correspondences under the pose convention x i ≈ R ​ y j + t x_{i}\approx Ry_{j}+t ; for complete matching, a tolerance on the mean residual corresponds to n n times that tolerance on the sum. The lemmas, propositions and theorems of this section assume exact arithmetic and exact assignment oracles, and Appendix E specifies the search procedures.

blocks.en: The search can be interrupted at any time: an interrupted evaluation leaves the previous bound of its arc in place, and the feasible updates that were completed are kept ( Theorem 24 ). Undoing the leveling and restoring the centroids recovers the pose in the original frame. blocks.en: The penalty on unmatched points has a transport interpretation. Give every point unit mass. At a fixed pose, unbalanced transport with a total-variation penalty on the marginals minimizes ∑ i ​ j P i ​ j ​ c i ​ j + λ ⁡ ( ‖ 𝟏 − P ​ 𝟏 ‖ 1 + ‖ 𝟏 − P ⊤ ​ 𝟏 ‖ 1 ) \sum_{ij}P_{ij}c_{ij}+\lambda(\|\mathbf{1}-P\mathbf{1}\|_{1}+\|\mathbf{1}-P^{\top}\mathbf{1}\|_{1}) over nonnegative P P , where c i ​ j = ‖ x i − R ​ y j − t ‖ 2 c_{ij}=\|x_{i}-Ry_{j}-t\|^{2} . Reducing the excess mass in a row decreases the penalty of that row by at least as much as it increases the penalties of the columns, and it does not increase the transport cost. The same argument applies to columns, so some optimal P P satisfies P ​ 𝟏 ≤ 𝟏 P\mathbf{1}\leq\mathbf{1} and P ⊤ ​ 𝟏 ≤ 𝟏 P^{\top}\mathbf{1}\leq\mathbf{1} . The objective is then ∑ i ​ j P i ​ j ​ ( c i ​ j − 2 ​ λ ) + λ ⁡ ( n + m ) \sum_{ij}P_{ij}(c_{ij}-2\lambda)+\lambda(n+m) , which is linear on the bipartite matching polytope, whose vertices are the partial matchings. blocks.en: The witness bound holds because the nonnegative interpolation weights extend the excess at the vertices throughout the cell, after which the common quadratic term is restored; Section D.2.1 proves both parts of the lemma. Minimizing the right-hand side of ( 18 ) over the cell gives a lower bound for the cell and, at the same time, a feasible pose for the witness; when Δ W = 0 \Delta_{W}=0 , this fit solves the cell. At a fixed yaw, the optimal e e is the difference between the centroids of the matched points after rotation, clipped to the translation box. Between changes of the clipping pattern, the cost is a trigonometric polynomial of degree two in the yaw, whose stationary points are the roots of a quartic. blocks.en: A vertex attains the maximum because the largest eigenvalue is convex, just as the planar optimum is attained at a farthest vertex of the polygon, and the reduction yields proper rotations, in agreement with the determinant correction of the Procrustes solution. Section D.4 proves the theorem, together with the rank formula and the finite exact construction.

blocks.en: The exact reduction is finite but comes without a polynomial bound. For every fixed dimension d ≥ 2 d\geq 2 , and in particular for d = 3 d=3 , we conjecture that the number of vertices of the matrix-correlation polytope grows superpolynomially in the worst case, with no uniform polynomial bound in n n ( Section B.3.1 ), and no reconstruction guarantee like the 2 ​ V 2V queries of Proposition 9 is known. We therefore use the reduction only to fit the matchings that are returned during a search over quaternion regions, in which each assignment query again shares one direction across all edges.
blocks.zh: 确切的还原量是有限的,但是没有多重约束。 对于每个固定维度d → 2 d\ geq 2, 特别是d = 3 d= 3, 我们推测, 基质-相通多管子的顶点数在最坏的情况下会长出上波, 并且没有统一的多管子绑在 n (B. 3. 1 节) , 也没有像 Proposation 9 的 2 V 2 V 质询 那样的重建保证. 因此,我们使用减法只是为了匹配在搜索超四角区域时返回的匹配,其中每个任务查询再次在所有边缘共享一个方向。

blocks.en: The score ( 24 ) is quadratic in q q but linear in the matrix Q = q ​ q ⊤ ∈ 𝕊 4 Q=qq^{\top}\in\mathbb{S}^{4} , which we call the lift of q q . This linearity lets assignment queries bound whole regions of rotations. We cover the rotations by four charts. In each chart, we choose a coordinate of the quaternion that has the largest magnitude, make it positive, and scale it to one, so that the other three coordinates lie in [ − 1 , 1 ] 3 [-1,1]^{3} . Splitting each of them at zero gives eight boxes per chart, hence 32 boxes that cover every proper rotation. The boxes overlap on their boundaries, which is harmless. Within each box, any two corners have a dot product of at least one.

Write q ~ = ∑ a α a ​ q ~ a \tilde{q}=\sum_{a}\alpha_{a}\tilde{q}_{a} with convex weights. Expanding the normalized lift gives a convex combination of the corner and cross-corner lifts, because their dot products are positive. Subtracting the linear score of the witness before interpolating, and then applying the Rayleigh inequality, gives the second. Sections D.5 and D.5.1 prove the enclosure, the coverage by charts and the convergence under refinement.

blocks.en: The enclosure is an instance of the convex-hull property of rational Bézier representations with positive weights [ 59 ] , and restricted to pure yaw rotations it recovers the triangle of Section 7.1 ( Figures 5 and D.5 ). If τ \tau attains the support value at every query, the bound equals the score of the feasible fit of τ \tau , so the cell is closed even when its residual is not zero. We minimize the witness bound over the available witnesses and combine it with two cheaper rotation-cap bounds , which depend only on the largest angular distance of the cell from its center ( Section D.6 ).

blocks.en: We apply a cheap valid bound first and reserve the exterior queries for the cells that remain unresolved. Tightening a cell updates its priority in the queue without subdividing it, and neighboring cells reuse geometry, witnesses and support values. Two devices reduce the number of assignment problems.

Feasible updates only decrease U U , so pruned regions remain excluded; complete child covers and inherited bounds retain every other candidate. On the finite compact root cover, the bounds converge to the physical values as the cells shrink. An infinite refinement would contain an infinite path along which the gap tends to zero, which contradicts the stopping rule for a least-bound cell. blocks.en: Solver comparisons fix the inputs, objective and evaluation; retrieval and classification fix the procedure and change only the distance. Registration comparisons change only the bound or matching subsolver within a fixed search procedure, the host . blocks.en: Timings include initialization, bound evaluation and feasible updates; paired comparisons use identical inputs and one processor core. Statistics include every test pair, with paired McNemar and Wilcoxon tests for retrieval and classification. Floating-point gaps are numerical; exact certificates concern rational planar inputs. Appendices F , F.9 , F.10 and F.14 give the protocols, Section F.1 describes the hardware, and Appendix G reports contextual results. We will release all code and dependencies.

blocks.en: APM [ 46 ] subdivides rectangles of matching statistics; RPM-PA [ 48 ] expands their convex hull to a prescribed tolerance. Both eliminate the transformation, but neither bounds the assignment count. For complete planar matching they search the correlation plane, where Rubix reconstructs the polygon in 2 ​ V 2V assignments with V ≤ n ⁡ ( n − 1 ) V\leq n(n-1) ( Theorems 2 and 9 ).

blocks.en: We run the authors’ APM code and our paper-based implementation of RPM-PA; the latter shares SciPy’s assignment solver with Python Rubix. All also optimize translation and nonnegative scale ( Section F.7 ). APM matches Rubix’s reference with 551–562 median assignments versus 25–31. RPM-PA has 45.5–66.0% excess rates at its published tolerance ε RPM = 0.3 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{RPM}}=0.3 and 4.5–13.5% at 0.01 0.01 . Zero tolerance removes excess but needs 50–60 median assignments, takes 9–37 times as long as Rubix and exceeds 120 s on 70 of 600 pairs ( Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们运行作者的APM代码和我们基于纸张的RPM-PA执行;后者与Python Rubix共享SciPy的任务解决器. 所有这些都优化了翻译和非负面比例(F.7节)。 APM将Rubix的参考文献与551–562的中位任务相匹配,相对于25–31. RPM-PA在其公布的可容忍度为45.5-6.0% = 0.3\varepsilon = mathrm{RPM = 0.3 和 4.5-13.5 % = 0.01。 零能耐消除过量但需要50-60个中位数任务,需要比Rubix多9-37倍,在600对任务中的70个超过120秒(表3)。

blocks.en: Table 3: Global solvers on 600 planar pairs. Complete similarity matching on Table 2 ’s inputs. Excess is the percentage of costs more than 1 % 1\% above the reference; assignments and milliseconds are single-core medians. RPM-PA is our implementation, sharing Python and SciPy assignment with Rubix; original APM runs under Octave with C++ assignment ( Section F.7 ). RPM-PA’s published tolerance is ε RPM = 0.3 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{RPM}}=0.3 ; zero tolerance exceeds 120 s on 70 pairs. Bold marks the fewest assignments and lowest time among zero-excess methods.
blocks.zh: 表3:600平面图对上的全球解析器. 表2的投入完全相似。 超额是高于参考值1%以上的成本百分比;任务和毫秒为单核心中位数。 RPM-PA是我们执行的,与Rubix共享Python和Scipy任务;原始APM运行于Octave下与C++任务(F.7节). RPM-PA公布的耐受度为 QQ RPM = 0.3\varepsilon _{\mathrm{RPM}}=0.3;70对零容忍度超过120 s. 粗体是零过度方法中任务最少和时间最少的。

blocks.en: 8.2 Retrieval and Material Classification
blocks.zh: 8.2 检索和材料分类

blocks.en: We fix each retrieval or classification procedure and vary only the distance: PW computed by Rubix or AM, or an alignment-free alternative. Section F.6 gives settings and diagnoses AM (PCA) failures.
blocks.zh: 我们固定了每个检索或分类程序,只改变距离:由Rubix或AM计算的PW,或一个无对齐的替代品。 F.6节给出了设置和诊断AM(PCA)故障.

blocks.en: MPEG-7 [ 37 ] has 1,400 silhouettes in 70 classes of 20. All methods use the same 64 boundary samples, centered and scaled to unit root-mean-square radius, for all 979,300 pairwise SO ⁡ ( 2 ) \mathrm{SO}(2) distances. Bullseye measures how many of the 20 same-class shapes occur among the nearest 40, including the query; leave-one-out 1-NN and mean average precision (mAP) exclude it.
blocks.zh: MPEG-7 [37] 在70个20个班级中拥有1400个轮廓. 所有方法都使用相同的64个边界标本,以正中并缩放为单位根-正平方半径,用于所有979,300对SO → (2)\mathrm{SO}(2)相距. 公牛座测量20个同等外形中有多少个出现在最接近的40个外形中,包括查询;一出一出1-NN并平均精度(mAP)排除.

blocks.en: AM (PCA) has more than 1 % 1\% excess on 37 % 37\% of pairs, with a maximum cost ratio of 51. Rubix improves all three retrieval measures; 246 queries gain same-class neighbors and 89 lose some ( Table 4 ). Across 14 settings, the alignment-free SE(2)-invariant distance SEINT [ 52 ] reaches at most 41.6 % 41.6\% bullseye and 67.4 % 67.4\% 1-NN, versus 67.4 % 67.4\% and 92.5 % 92.5\% for Rubix (McNemar p < 10 − 79 p<10^{-79} ). SEINT is faster, at 0.34 0.34 versus 5.35 5.35 ms per distance, but no setting matches Rubix’s accuracy ( Section F.6.1 ).
blocks.zh: AM(PCA)在37%的37\%对上超标超过1% 1\%,最高成本比为51. Rubix改进了所有三项检索措施;246项查询获得同级邻居,89项损失部分(表4)。 在14个设置中,无对齐的SE(2)-invariant距离SEINT[52]最多达到41.6%的公牛眼和67.4%的67.4%的1-NN,对鲁比克(McNemar p < 10-79 p < 10-Q-79})而言,SEINT速度更快,每距离0.34 0.34比5.35 ms,但没有设置与鲁比克克的准确性相匹配(F.6.1节)。

blocks.en: Table 4: Retrieval on all 1,400 MPEG-7 silhouettes ( n = 64 n=64 ), measured by bullseye score, leave-one-out 1-NN accuracy and mean average precision (%). The first three rows are PW distances computed by the named solver. GW is the Gromov–Wasserstein distance, SEINT [ 52 ] is an SE(2)-invariant transport metric, shown in its original classification setting and in the best of its 14 tested settings, and W 2 W_{2} is the 2-Wasserstein distance without rotation. Bold marks the highest score in each column.
blocks.zh: 表4:所有1400 MPEG-7 silhouets(n = 64 n = 64)的检索,以牛眼分数,一出一出1-NN精度和平均精度(%)来测量. 前三行由被命名的解析器所计算的PW距离. GW是Gromov–Wasserstein相距,SEINT [52]是SE(2)-invariant的迁移度量衡,显示于其最初的分类设置及其14个被测试的设置中最好的一个,而W 2 W_{2}是2-Wasserstein相距而无旋转. 粗体标出每栏最高分.

blocks.en: We classify atomic neighborhoods up to rotation [ 36 , 10 ] in square, triangular, honeycomb and kagome lattices with unit nearest-neighbor spacing and Gaussian displacements of standard deviation σ noise \sigma_{\mathrm{noise}} . Each neighborhood contains a site and its 23 nearest neighbors, is centered on the site, normalized and randomly rotated. Five independent draws per noise level each supply ten labels and 50 tests per class for 1-NN classification.
blocks.zh: 我们以正方形、三角形、蜂窝和kagome lattices的相距单位和高斯人对标准偏差的偏差进行分类。 每个街区都有一个站点及其23个最近的邻居,以站点为中心,实现常态化并随机旋转. 每个噪声级别有5个独立抽取,每个级别提供10个标签和50个测试,用于1-NN分类.

blocks.en: AM (PCA) has more than 1 % 1\% excess in 74–80% of comparisons. At σ noise = 0.12 \sigma_{\mathrm{noise}}=0.12 , Rubix correctly classifies 889 of 1,000 tests, versus 770 for AM (PCA) and 835 for ten-start AM ( Table A.5 ). A 36-angle grid ties Rubix at noise 0.08 0.08 and 0.12 0.12 and correctly classifies one more at 0.16 0.16 : dense angular search also recovers accuracy lost to initialization. Rubix’s advantage over AM persists across neighborhood sizes and label counts ( Table A.7 ).
blocks.zh: AM(PCA)在74-80%的比较中超额超过1%. Rubix正确将889个测试分为1000个测试, 噪音为0.080.08和0.120.12时的36角网格链接Rubix,并正确分类为0.160.16时再一个:密集角搜索也恢复了被初始化所损失的精度. Rubix对AM的优势,

blocks.en: On a separate 600-test comparison per noise level, alignment-free methods lead near ideal lattices ( Table A.7 ). At noise 0.08 0.08 , a bond-orientational descriptor reaches 99.2 % 99.2\% versus Rubix’s 92.7 % 92.7\% ; at 0.04 0.04 , SEINT reaches 100.0 % 100.0\% versus 97.8 % 97.8\% (McNemar p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). SEINT’s 93.7 % 93.7\% at 0.08 0.08 does not differ significantly from Rubix ( p = 0.54 p=0.54 ).
blocks.zh: 在对每个噪音水平进行600次测试的单独比较中,无对齐方法导致接近理想的纬度(表A.7)。 在0.08 0.08 噪声中,债券导向描述符达到99.2% 99.2\%,而Rubix的92.7% 92.7\%;在0.04 0.04 时,SEINT达到100.0% 100.0.0\%,而97.8\%(McNemar p < 0.001 p < 0.001 ). SEINT的93.7% 93.7\%在0.08 时与Rubix(p= 0.54 p= 0.54)没有显著区别.

blocks.en: At noise 0.16 0.16 , Rubix instead reaches 82.3 % 82.3\% , versus 57.8 % 57.8\% for the descriptor, 53.5 % 53.5\% for GW [ 4 ] and 44.8 % 44.8\% for SEINT. No SEINT setting matches Rubix at noise 0.12 0.12 , 0.16 0.16 or 0.20 0.20 , although it costs 0.16 0.16 versus 1.0 1.0 ms per distance ( Section F.6.1 ). Rubix also outperforms original Fiedler–W [ 2 ] and our Ping-Pong reproduction [ 25 ] at all five noise levels, with median paired speedups of 5.87–6.00 and 27.0–27.8 ( Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 在0.16.0.16的噪音中,Rubix则达到了82.3%的82.3\%,而描述词的为57.8%的为57.8\%,GW[4]的为53.5%的为53.5\%,SEINT的为44.8%的为44.8\%. SEINT设置在噪声0.120.12,0.160.16或0.200.20时没有与Rubix相匹配,尽管每相距0.160.16相比1.0米(F.6.1节)。 鲁比克还超越了原有的菲德勒-W [2]和我们的乒乓球再生[25]所有5个噪声级别,中位对联速度为5.87–6.00和27.0–27.8(表5).

blocks.en: Table 5: Published solvers as distance subroutines for lattice classification. Accuracy is the mean ± \pm sample standard deviation (%) across three draws, which total 600 tests per noise level. Bold marks a higher mean accuracy than both other solvers. These draws are shared with the descriptor and GW comparisons and differ from the five draws of Table A.5 ( Section F.7 ).
blocks.zh: 表5:被公布的解析器作为来龙去脉分类的距离子例程. 精确度是三次抽取的 ±\pm 样本标准差 (%) 的平均值, 每一次噪音水平总共600次测试 。 粗体标出比其他两个解题者更高的平均精度. 这些图纸与描述符和GW比较共享,与表A.5(F.7节)的5个图纸不同。

blocks.en: Three synthetic polycrystals each contain eight randomly oriented grains of the four lattices. On their 3,267 shared interior test atoms, Rubix reduces AM’s 797 errors to 467 ( 41.4 % 41.4\% ); SEINT makes 1,040 errors at its best setting and 1,622 at its original setting ( Figure A.3 ).
blocks.zh: 3个合成多晶体各含有4个纬度的8个随机取向的谷物. 在3,267个共享内部测试原子上,Rubix将AM的797个出错减少到了467个(41.4%为41.4);SEINT在最佳设置上出错1,040个,在最初设置上出错1,622个(图A.3).

blocks.en: Clustering 200 neighborhoods into four groups by k-medoids gives Rubix a higher adjusted Rand index (ARI) than AM at every noise level; average-linkage gains depend on the agreement measure ( Tables A.9 and F.6.2 ). Best-setting SEINT leads k-medoids at noise 0.08 0.08 (ARI 0.70 0.70 versus 0.55 0.55 ), but trails Rubix at 0.12 0.12 and 0.16 0.16 and under average linkage throughout.
blocks.zh: 由k-medoids将200个街区组合成4个组,使Rubix在每个噪声级别上得到比AM更高的调整后Rand指数(ARI);平均链接收益取决于协议计量(表A.9和F.6.2). 最佳设定 SINT在噪音为0.08 0.08(ARI 0.70 0.70对0.55 0.55)时引导出克-介素,但跟踪到Rubix在0.12 0.12和0.16 0.16之间,并在整个过程中处于平均链接下.

blocks.en: 8.3 Unbalanced Alignment
blocks.zh: 8.3 不平衡的对齐

blocks.en: A bijection forces unrelated points to match under partial overlap. The penalized model ( 13 ) charges λ \lambda per unmatched point and globally optimizes matching and rotation. Its equivalence to rigid TV-unbalanced transport ( Remark 16 ) motivates comparisons with unbalanced GW (UGW) [ 68 ] , fused UGW [ 72 ] and partial GW [ 17 ] . Synthetic and lattice tests supply the rotation center as an anchor; fused UGW receives distances to it as features. Every method uses validation-selected settings. Scans have no validation split, so GW pipelines receive their best test settings ( Section F.9 ).
blocks.zh: 在部分重叠的情况下,双弹出会迫使不相关的分数相匹配. 受罚模式 (13) 收费 \\\ lambda 每无相配点,全球优化匹配和旋转. 其与刚性TV-不均匀运输的等同性(注16)推动了与不平衡的GW(UGW)[68]的比较,使UGW[72]和部分GW[17]的比较. 合成和丝网试验提供自转中心作为锚;被熔接的UGW作为特性接收到相距. 每种方法都使用校验选择的设置. 扫描没有验证分解,因此GW管道得到其最好的测试设置(F.9节.

blocks.en: On 40-point planar sets, Rubix recovers rotations within 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} in at least 99% of tests at every shared fraction, down to 30% ( Table 6 ). Our diagnostic calls a miss a solver failure if a true-correspondence restart improves a GW objective and recovers the rotation, or Rubix closes AM’s gap at the same penalty and recovers it. Other misses are objective failures ; for GW this classification does not establish global optimality ( Section F.9.2 ). Balanced Rubix closes every gap but misses 403 of 800 rotations. Sixteen-start AM misses 29, including 26 solver failures; penalized Rubix misses five. GW methods show both categories ( Table A.16 ).
blocks.zh: 在40分的平板机上,Rubix在至少99%的测试中,在每个共享分数中恢复了5分以内的旋转,下降到30%(表6). 我们的诊断认为,如果真信号重启会改善GW目标并恢复自转,或者Rubix将AM的空隙关闭在同一惩罚中并恢复,那么就会出现故障。 其他缺失是客观的失误;GW认为这种分类不能确定全球最佳性(F.9.2节)。 平衡的Rubix关闭了每一个空档,但错过了800个轮换中的403个. 16起AM失手29起,包括26起解答失败;处罚Rubix失手5起. GW方法显示了这两个类别(表A.16)。

blocks.en: Selecting settings by validation correspondence F1 also makes Rubix the most accurate matcher, at 10–18 ms per solve versus 32–88 ms for UGW. At 160 points per set, Rubix recovers every rotation with a closed gap in median time 0.43 s, versus 46% recovery in 1.4 s for UGW ( Section F.9.3 ).
blocks.zh: 通过验证函证F1选择设置,也使Rubix成为最准确的匹配者,每解10–18 ms相较于UGW的32–88 ms. 每套160分,Rubix每回转一次,中间时间相差0.43秒,而UGW的回转率为1.4秒(F.9.3节)。

blocks.en: Quaternion search ( Section 7.4 ) closes all gaps and recovers all rotations in 200 tests with 24-point sets, at a median 0.5 s versus 0.002–0.05 s for GW methods. At 30% overlap, fused UGW recovers 38%, 60-start AM 34%, and UGW and partial GW at most 2% ( Tables A.13 and F.9.4 ).
blocks.zh: Quternion搜索(第7.4节)在200个测试中,用24个点集,以中位数0.5s对0.002-0.05s的GW方法,关闭了所有缺口并恢复了所有旋转. 在30%重叠时,引信UGW恢复了38%,60起AM恢复了34%,UGW和部分GW恢复了最多2%(表A.13和F.9.4)。

blocks.en: Fixed-size neighborhoods fill vacancies with atoms from the next shell; a fixed radius instead preserves variable cardinality. At thermal noise 0.08 0.08 , penalized Rubix on radius- 2.6 2.6 neighborhoods exceeds balanced Rubix on 24-atom neighborhoods by 18.5–30.5 percentage points as defect rates rise from 0.1 0.1 to 0.3 0.3 (McNemar p ≤ 1.5 × 10 − 10 p\leq 1.5\times 10^{-10} ; Table 6 ). It also exceeds UGW and fused UGW ( p ≤ 2 × 10 − 3 p\leq 2\times 10^{-3} ), partial GW and SEINT [ 52 ] . With no defects, Rubix and UGW reach 100%; at every nonzero defect rate, 16-start AM ties Rubix. Here the improvement comes from variable-size neighborhoods and penalized matching, without further benefit from global search.
blocks.zh: 固定大小的邻里用下个外壳的原子来填充空缺;而固定的半径则保留了可变的主干. 在热噪声0.08 0.08时,半径受罚的Rubix -- -- 2.6 2.6个街区超过24个原子街区平衡的Rubix18.5-30.5个百分点,因为缺陷率从0.1升至0.3 (McNemar p. 1.5 × 10-10 p\leq 1.5\times 10-10};表6)。 它也超过了UGW并被熔化了UGW(第2页×10-3页p\leq 2\times 10^{-3}),部分GW和SEINT[52]. 在没有缺陷的情况下,Rubix和UGW达到了100%;在每一个非零缺陷率下,16起AM连接Rubix. 这里的改善来自可变大小的邻里和受罚的相配,而没有从全球搜索中进一步受益.

blocks.en: All identified ETH scan pairs of Li et al. [ 43 ] yield gravity-aligned problems on representative subsets, or coresets , of 64 source and 80 target points. With reference translation, Rubix recovers 27 of 31 yaws within 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} and closes every gap in median time 36 ms; offsetting translation by 0.5 m gives 25 recoveries. Best-setting fused UGW recovers 23 and 19, and 16-start AM 22 and 20 ( Tables A.15 and F.9.5 ). Gains over UGW and partial GW are significant ( p ≤ 1.5 × 10 − 4 p\leq 1.5\times 10^{-4} ), but those over fused UGW and AM are not ( p ≥ 0.12 p\geq 0.12 ). With translations from Li et al. [ 43 ] or RAP [ 57 ] , Rubix recovers 20 and 23 yaws, leading the matchers but trailing each front end’s 25 native yaws.
blocks.zh: 所有经鉴定的EH扫描对李等. [43] 在64个源和80个目标点的代表性子集或核心集上产生重力相通的问题。 参考翻译中,Rubix在 5 ∘ 5 ^{\ Circ 以 5 ∘ 中取回了 31 个 yaws 中的 27 个,并用 中位时间 相隔 36 ms 的 相抵翻译 0. 5 m 的 相抵翻译 得到 25 个 回收 . 安装最佳的UGW回收23和19,以及16起AM22和20(表A.15和F.9.5)。 超过UGW和部分GW的收益相当可观(第1.5页×第10页-第4页p\leq 第1.5和10页+第4页),但超过已引信的UGW和AM则不是(第0.12页p\geq 第0.12页)。 Rubix从李等译出[43]或RAP[57],

blocks.en: Despite 44% median voxel overlap, independently sampled coresets often occupy different surfaces: the reference penalized matching contains a median of eight source points. Three of Rubix’s four misses have at most three such points ( Figure 7 ). Among 17 pairs with fewer than ten, Rubix recovers 14 yaws, fused UGW 13, AM 10, partial GW 3 and UGW 1. Controlled synthetic overlap shows a similar decline for GW methods.
blocks.zh: 尽管有44%的中位阴道重叠,但独立采样的芯片集往往占据了不同的表面:被处罚的参考匹配包含一个由8个源点组成的中位数. Rubix的四名失职者中,有三名失职者最多有三分(图7)。 在17对小于10只的舰只中,Rubix回收了14只,装有引信的UGW 13、AM 10、部分GW 3和UGW 1. 联合国 受控合成重叠显示GW方法的类似下降.

blocks.en: When translation is unknown, GLORES [ 20 ] with Rubix bounds registers 190 of 212 laser-scan configurations, versus 169 for UGW plus trimmed ICP, 151 for partial GW plus trimmed ICP and 139 for ICP alone ( p ≤ 6 × 10 − 6 p\leq 6\times 10^{-6} ; Table A.17 ). Native GLORES registers 189, so both global searches share the pose advantage. GW needs neither supplied translation nor a common frame; Rubix needs an anchor or a host that searches translation. Section F.9.5 also evaluates our Python port of Li et al.’s MATLAB solver [ 42 ] , which receives no translation.
blocks.zh: 当翻译不明时,GLORES [20] 与Rubix捆绑在212个激光扫描构型中登记了190个,而UGW外加已修饰的比较方案为169个,部分GW外加已修饰的比较方案为151个,单是比较方案为139个(第6页×第10页×第6页x第6页x第6页x第10页x6页;表A.17)。 原生GLORES注册了189,因此两个全球搜索都分享了姿势优势. GW既不需要提供翻译,也不需要通用的框架;Rubix需要一个主播或搜索翻译的主机. F.9.5节还评价了我们的Python港Li等的MATLAB解析器[42],该解析器没有收到翻译。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Partial alignments found by Rubix and missed by unbalanced GW. (a) 40-point sets with 30% overlap: targets are rings (shared targets dark); rotated sources are solid when shared. Titles give rotation errors. (b) A noisy square neighborhood ( σ noise = 0.08 \sigma_{\mathrm{noise}}=0.08 ): observed atoms are rings and the site a cross-hair. blocks.en: 8.4 Registration with Rubix Bounds
blocks.zh: 8.4 Rubix Boundes的登记

blocks.en: We insert Rubix bounds into native GLORES [ 20 ] , real gravity-aligned matching, and synthetic yaw, joint yaw–translation and full-rotation searches. Each comparison fixes the host objective, search policy, feasible updates and stopping rule. A native method uses its authors’ implementation and objective. The independent-edge bound minimizes each edge separately over a cell before assignment, allowing different poses per edge. The vertex bound uses Rubix’s assignments at the yaw-triangle vertices but takes their smallest value, isolating the benefit of minimizing the interpolant on the arc.
blocks.zh: 我们把Rubix 的边界插入本地 GLORES [20], 真正的重力相匹配, 以及合成的 yaw, 联合 yaw 翻译和全旋转搜索 。 每次比较都会确定主机的目标,搜索政策,可行的更新和停止规则. 本地方法采用作者的实施和目标。 独立边缘绑定在任务前将每个边缘分别放在单元格上最小化,允许每个边缘有不同的外观. 顶点约束使用Rubix在横弧上的任务,但取出最小值,从而隔离了将弧上插点最小化的好处。

blocks.en: 8.4.1 A Rubix Bound inside GLORES
blocks.zh: 8.4.1 GLORES内部的Rubix Bonder

blocks.en: GLORES [ 20 ] searches planar rotation and translation to minimize the k = ⌈ ρ keep ​ n ⌉ k=\lceil\rho_{\mathrm{keep}}n\rceil smallest squared nearest-neighbor distances from source to target. This trimmed, directed objective allows unequal sizes, repeated targets and unmatched sources. We replace each yaw-interval–translation-box bound by the larger of its native and Rubix bounds; all added queries are timed.

We test two Rubix bounds. The first applies the arc interpolation of Section 7.1 to the yaw interval and relaxes the translation independently for each point. The second, stronger bound keeps one translation common to all selected pairs. Following Lemma 18 , it subtracts k k times the squared distance to the center of the box, which makes the objective concave separately in the yaw coordinates and in the translation, and then combines the interpolants at the four corners of the box ( Section D.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们测试两个Rubix的界限。 第一种是将7.1节的弧插法应用到yaw间隔上,并独立地为每个点放松翻译. 第二,更强的边框保留着一个翻译对所有被选中的对子都是通用的. 在Lemma 18之后,它会减去正方形相距到盒子中央的kk倍,这使得目标集合在yaw坐标和翻译中分开来,然后在盒子的四角结合插件(D.3节.

blocks.en: Sixty Hokuyo scan pairs from three IILABS sequences [ 62 ] , acquired at different times, yield 240 configurations with two beam counts and two retained fractions ( Section F.8 ). All four bounds reach the native 1 % 1\% tolerance throughout. Arc interpolation gives a median paired speedup of 1.067 1.067 ; common translation raises it to 1.331 1.331 and reduces nodes by a factor of 1.844 1.844 ( Table 7 ). The common-translation bound is faster throughout, with a scan-pair-stratified bootstrap interval of [ 1.296 , 1.376 ] [1.296,1.376] . Pose success remains essentially unchanged, at 190 versus 189 of 212 reference configurations.

blocks.zh: 8.4.2 匹配来自 Real 三维扫描的子问题

blocks.en: We test six adjacent Office and Courtyard scan pairs from ETH [ 71 ] . Pairs share scans and are not independent. Without measured IMU calibration, we use the scanner’s nominal + z +z axis as gravity; reference poses serve only evaluation.

blocks.en: Complete SE(3) alignment uses 72 synthetic scenes with n ∈ { 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 } n\in\{8,16,32,64\} , three point distributions, two noise levels and centered inputs. Rubix adds exterior support queries and witness bounds to the quaternion host with rotation-cap bounds, keeping its search policy and assignment solver fixed ( Algorithms A.3 and F.14.3 ).

The nine host timeouts close in 1.00–6.18 s with Rubix, giving speedup lower bounds of 2.43 2.43 – 15.06 15.06 . Section G.7 compares five bound-selection policies.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: Rubix solves planar PW alignment through the permutation polygon. Its sharp n ⁡ ( n − 1 ) n(n-1) vertex bound answers Rote’s question [ 55 ] and yields an exact 𝒪 ⁡ ( n 5 ) \mathcal{O}(n^{5}) algorithm, with output-sensitive cost 𝒪 ⁡ ( n 3 ​ V ) \mathcal{O}(n^{3}V) for V V vertices. Under the stated initialization and tie rules, AM visits matchings with vertex correlations; a visited matching with nonzero correlation is fixed exactly when its vertex is stationary. Rubix selects a farthest vertex. The resulting distances improve retrieval, noisy crystal classification and k-medoids clustering over AM, while penalized partial matching handles incomplete sets. Spatial assignment bounds reduce registration search cost by retaining a common pose across residuals; pose accuracy remains a separate criterion.
blocks.zh: Rubix通过平面多边形解决了平面PW对齐. 它的尖锐的n-(n− 1)n(n−1)顶点绑定解答了罗特的问题 [55],并产生了精确的O-(n (5)\ mathcal{O} (n−5})算法,其输出敏感成本为O-(n−3 V)\mathcal{O} (n−3}V) 对于V V 顶点. 根据所声明的初始化和平局规则,AM访问与顶点相匹配;访问与非零相匹配的顶点在固定时被固定. 鲁比克选择了最远的顶点. 由此产生的距离改进了检索、吵闹的晶体分类和在AM上聚集的克-medoids,同时惩罚部分匹配的手柄不全。 空间分配界限通过保留各种剩余物的常见外观来降低登记搜索成本;准确性仍然是一个单独的标准。

blocks.en: The quadratic bound requires equal planar weights. Rational weights with common denominator N ≥ 2 N\geq 2 need at most N ⁡ ( N − 1 ) N(N-1) representatives by duplication, but three unequally weighted points can already give 8 > 6 8>6 vertices ( Corollaries 8 and C.2.2 ). Exactness requires exact assignment and support comparisons. Partial matching with free translation needs a registration host or our joint search, which currently reaches tens of points. Spatial guarantees depend on numerical scale and tolerance and do not establish exact polynomial complexity in the input bit length ( Propositions 14 and 19 ). A closed numerical gap need not recover the pose: gravity bias can leave errors invisible to the objective ( Sections G.6 and F.13 ). Shared scans and reused scan pairs also make the ETH and planar samples dependent.

blocks.en: We conjecture superpolynomial worst-case vertex growth in n n for the full matrix-correlation polytope in each fixed dimension d ≥ 2 d\geq 2 ( Section B.3.1 ); the planar scalar-correlation polygon proved here is distinct. blocks.en: This appendix proves the planar reduction, the vertex bound and the guarantees of the algorithm. The proof of the bound has three ingredients. Assignment duality constrains the cycle of reassigned points at a transition; a count of continuous angle changes determines the phase jump of the cycle; and genericity, with a perturbation argument and an accounting over a full turn, extends the bound to all inputs. The subsections follow the order in which the results depend on each other.

Otherwise, for each v l v_{l} we choose a unit direction u l u_{l} that exposes v l v_{l} alone, and we choose δ > 0 \delta>0 below every positive score gap between v l v_{l} and another correlation in direction u l u_{l} , and below half of every distance between two distinct vertices. By Lemma A.2 , there is a generic pair within distance δ pert \delta_{\mathrm{pert}} that moves each correlation by less than δ / 3 \delta/3 . Every maximizer in direction u l u_{l} then comes from a correlation that originally equaled v l v_{l} , so a vertex of the exposed face lies within δ / 3 \delta/3 of v l v_{l} , also when the face is an edge. These neighborhoods are disjoint, which yields at least k k distinct vertices.

blocks.en:
By (G2), a supporting line contains at most two distinct correlations, and by (G1) these belong to at most two maximizing permutations. If σ \sigma and τ \tau both maximize, we decompose σ − 1 ​ τ \sigma^{-1}\tau into disjoint nontrivial cycles. Switching one cycle cannot raise the projection Re ⁡ ( u ¯ ​ z ) \operatorname{Re}(\bar{u}z) , because σ \sigma is optimal. The cycles move disjoint rows, so these changes sum to the change from σ \sigma to τ \tau , which is zero, and each of them is zero. If there were two cycles, switching only one of them would give a third maximizer, which contradicts genericity. Thus the relative permutation is a single nontrivial cycle.

blocks.en: A.8.1 Polygon Reconstruction

blocks.en:
If the two initial outputs have the same correlation, both the real extrema and the opposite secondary imaginary extrema coincide. Thus 𝒫 \mathcal{P} is a point and two calls suffice. Otherwise, the two initial chords represent complementary boundary arcs. A positive support gap splits its arc at a vertex strictly between the endpoints, and a zero gap confirms an edge. Pending arcs have disjoint interiors and exclude their endpoints, so no vertex is discovered twice: each query adds a vertex or confirms an edge. Each initial arc generates a binary tree with the splits as internal nodes and the confirmed edges as leaves. Together these trees have V − 2 V-2 internal nodes and V V leaves, which gives 2 + ( V − 2 ) + V = 2 ​ V 2+(V-2)+V=2V calls, including the initialization. For a segment, the two directed copies of the chord give four calls. Theorem 2 bounds V V , regardless of how many permutations represent a vertex.
∎

blocks.en: Table A.1 summarizes what is known for different classes of transformations and weights. It combines the equal-weight bounds of Theorems 2 and 10 with the extension to rational weights in Corollary 8 , in which the replication argument supplies representative transport plans by aggregating matchings of the copied points. The resulting algorithm is pseudo-polynomial in the common denominator N N , whose value can be exponential in its bit length. Uniform weights on n n and m m points use N = lcm ⁡ ( n , m ) ≤ n ​ m N=\operatorname{lcm}(n,m)\leq nm , which is polynomial in the sizes of the point sets. Section B.3 derives the formulations with matrix correlations for rotations in higher dimension and for unrestricted linear maps.

blocks.en: The scalar polygon of Theorem 2 retains only the two correlation coordinates that planar rotations need. The full matrix hull 𝒞 \mathcal{C} retains all d 2 d^{2} entries and can have vertices that are lost under that planar projection. Let V d ​ ( n ) V_{d}(n) denote the largest number of vertices of 𝒞 \mathcal{C} over X , Y ∈ ℝ d × n X,Y\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n} . We conjecture that, for each fixed d ≥ 2 d\geq 2 , V d ​ ( n ) V_{d}(n) grows superpolynomially: V d ​ ( n ) V_{d}(n) is not 𝒪 ⁡ ( n k ) \mathcal{O}(n^{k}) for any fixed k k . In other words, no polynomial in n n bounds the number of vertices of the full hull uniformly over the inputs, and this would hold in particular at each fixed d ≥ 3 d\geq 3 , because padding planar inputs with zero coordinates preserves their matrix-correlation hull and its number of vertices. The conjecture concerns the full hull; the number of vertices that are needed for physical rotation queries alone is a separate question. The 16 16 -vertex example refutes only the particular bound n ⁡ ( n − 1 ) n(n-1) and does not establish the conjectured asymptotic growth.

blocks.en: The following examples apply the construction of Proposition 7 and the verification procedure of Proposition 11 , whose proofs are in Sections A.7.2 and A.9 . They show that a hull computed in floating point can miss vertices that exact arithmetic distinguishes. The tight instance uses a j = j − 1 a_{j}=j-1 and b j = 2 j − 1 + i ​ 4 j − 1 b_{j}=2^{j-1}+\mathrm{i}4^{j-1} for j = 1 , … , 20 j=1,\ldots,20 . blocks.en: The cheaper independent-edge bound minimizes each edge over the cell before the constrained assignment, so each edge may use a different pose. For each edge it adds the squared horizontal distance between the arc and the rectangle to the squared vertical distance between the intervals. The horizontal distance is attained at an endpoint of the arc, at an intersection with a supporting line of the rectangle, at a coordinate tangency, or in the radial direction of a nonzero corner: a zero residual first occurs at an endpoint or at such an intersection, and elsewhere stationarity in the angle gives a tangency when one coordinate is clipped and a corner direction when both are clipped. Degenerate rectangles and circles of radius zero are included. The subsequent assignment still enforces the anchor and the cardinality, and the matching that it returns is fitted at one common pose for feasible updates.

blocks.en: The joint-gravity case of Theorem 24 requires that the regional gap vanishes under refinement, when the yaw and every active translation coordinate shrink along refined paths. For a fixed anchor and cardinality, write F ⁡ ( θ , e ) = min M ⁡ E M ​ ( θ , e ) F(\theta,e)=\min_{M}E_{M}(\theta,e) over the admissible matchings. As nested cells shrink to ( θ 0 , e 0 ) (\theta_{0},e_{0}) , the minimum E W min E_{W}^{\min} of a fixed witness W W over the cell tends to E W ​ ( θ 0 , e 0 ) E_{W}(\theta_{0},e_{0}) . The common quadratic term cancels in the differences at the vertices, so Δ W \Delta_{W} tends to E W ​ ( θ 0 , e 0 ) − F ⁡ ( θ 0 , e 0 ) E_{W}(\theta_{0},e_{0})-F(\theta_{0},e_{0}) . Thus E W min − Δ W E_{W}^{\min}-\Delta_{W} tends to F ⁡ ( θ 0 , e 0 ) F(\theta_{0},e_{0}) also when the limiting slack is not zero. blocks.en:
A valid interval alone does not guarantee that the search finishes. Termination also requires progress: yaw arcs and the longest quaternion coordinates are bisected, and the joint gravity search must shrink the yaw and every active translation coordinate. Tightening must eventually yield to subdivision, and adaptive evaluations must retain a regional bound and feasible updates whose gap vanishes under refinement. The vanishing gaps follow from Section D.1.2 for conditional yaw, Section D.2.3 for joint gravity, and Section D.5.1 for the quaternion search. An infinite tree with finitely many roots and finitely many children per node would contain an infinite path, along which progress makes the gap vanish. Once the gap of a least-bound cell is at most ε \varepsilon , its feasible value puts the global incumbent within ε \varepsilon of the live lower bound, which prevents further subdivision. This contradiction proves finite termination without a budget. Beyond the count of Proposition 14 for conditional yaw, no polynomial bound on the number of regions follows.

blocks.en: This search combines the fit for a fixed permutation of Theorem 20 with the regional enclosure of Lemma 21 . Complete matching permits centering before the quaternion search. For equally weighted complete sets of common size n > 0 n>0 , FitSE3 is the quaternion fit for a fixed permutation of Section D.4 , including eigenvalue ties. The fitted permutation is feasible without reassignment, and empty inputs have value zero.

blocks.en: The regional evaluation starts with the cheaper rotation-cap bounds and proceeds to the exterior queries only for the boxes that remain unresolved. The set 𝒲 \mathcal{W} of witnesses for the bound ( 30 ) contains the incumbent and all permutations returned at the center, by the cap bounds and by completed exterior queries.

blocks.en: The order shown, with the cap bounds first, is one valid schedule of the evaluation. An adaptive schedule may replace it by the difference bound ( 33 ), by repaired duals or by the full set of queries, while retaining the inherited bounds; Section D.7.1 proves that these alternatives are valid. For termination without a budget, a box that remains unresolved receives the physical assignment at its center and the complete exterior-query bound before it is subdivided, unless the replacement also has a gap that vanishes under refinement ( Sections D.5.1 and D.8 ). The partial extension of Section D.9 fixes the translation and does not solve unrestricted partial SE(3) registration.
blocks.zh: 所显示的顺序,以上限为先,是评价的一个有效时间表. 适应性时间表可取而代之的是受约束的区别(33),被修复的双重或全套查询,同时保留继承的界限;D.7.1节证明这些替代办法是有效的。 对于没有预算的终止,一个仍未解决的盒子在中心得到实际分配,在重新划分之前得到完整的外向干燥,除非更换时还有一段缺口在改进中消失(D.5.1和D.8节)。 D.9节的部分扩展修正了翻译,没有解决部分SE(3)注册不受限制的问题.

blocks.en: Original NumPy SEINT [ 52 ] uses the same centered, scaled inputs. Its original setting maximizes discrepancy over 50 random radius-2 references; ISEINT averages it. blocks.en: Eight uniform sites partition a 50 × 50 50\times 50 square into Voronoi grains. Each lattice fills two grains at uniform random orientations and offsets. blocks.en: Our reproduction of Ping-Pong [ 25 ] uses γ j PP = 1 / ( j + 2 ) \gamma^{\mathrm{PP}}_{j}=1/(j+2) , at most 1,000 Frank–Wolfe and 100 alternating steps. RPM-PA and Rubix share single-threaded Python, one processor core and SciPy’s assignment solver.

blocks.en: F.8 Planar Laser-Scan Registration
blocks.zh: F.8 激光扫描仪登记

blocks.en: Original GLORES [ 20 ] and PLICP [ 16 ] use IILABS [ 62 ] sequences slippage , nav_a_omni , loop . Scans at ten acquisition-time quantiles pair with scans one and five seconds later, yielding 60 pairs. Using 128 or 256 beams and retained fractions ρ keep \rho_{\mathrm{keep}} of 0.7 0.7 or 0.9 0.9 gives 240 configurations. The search spans all yaw and translations in [ − 5 , 5 ] 2 [-5,5]^{2} m at fixed scale, with relaxation thresholds of 0.1 0.1 , tolerance 1 % 1\% , and soft and hard limits of 120 and 150 s. PLICP starts at zero or 16 equally spaced yaws, using centroid translation for nonzero starts and native rejection, and minimizes error per retained point. The 28 configurations without reference poses enter timing only.
blocks.zh: 原作GLORES [20]和PLICP [16] 使用IILABS [62] 序列出错. nav_a_omni, rop. 扫描在10个收购时间的量子对一秒后扫描出60对. 使用128或256个束并保留分数 ^ \rho_{\mathrm{ kkeep}} 0.7 或 0.9 0.9 给240 个配置 。 搜索范围为[− 5, 5] 2 [5, 5] ^{2] m, 固定比例, 放松阈值为 0.1 ; 容忍度为1% ; 软硬限制为 120和 150 s. PLICP起于0或16个等距的yaws,使用centroid翻译来进行非零起止和原生拒绝,并尽量减少每个保留点出错. 无参考文献的28个配置仅构成输入时间.

blocks.en: We use the common-translation construction of Lemmas 18 and D.3 . Tangent triangles use half-widths in ( 0 , π / 3 ] (0,\pi/3] ; below 10 − 7 10^{-7} we use the minimum vertex value. Cardinality stays fixed per cell. All variants split wide arcs into three and share roundoff safeguards, including a coordinate-scaled guard; nonimproving queries stop early. GLORES has no polynomial guarantee. When the search terminates normally, its lower bound is 0.99 ​ U 0.99U ; when it is interrupted, the lower bound is min ⁡ ( L raw , 0.99 ​ U ) \min(L_{\rm raw},0.99U) , which accounts for the cells that were pruned within the tolerance.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Lemmas 18和D.3的通译结构。 正弦三角形在 (0, π / 3) (0,\pi/3) 中使用半圆;在 10 下 − 7 10- 7) 中使用最小顶点值. 主教座堂每间都固定着 所有变体将宽弧分割为3个并共享围挡,包括一个坐标级的护卫;不改进查询提前停止. GLORES没有多边担保。 当搜索正常终止时,其下限为0.99 U 0.99U;被中断时,下限为min ⁡ (L 生, 0.99 U )\min (L_{\rm 生}, 0.99U),这说明在可容忍度内被挤压的细胞.

blocks.en: Rubix-U applies Algorithm 2 to ( 13 ) with zero heights, anchor-centered rotation, absolute gap 10 − 6 ​ λ ​ ( n + m ) 10^{-6}\lambda(n+m) , and limits of 20,000 assignments and 10 s. AM-U alternates penalized assignment and rotation from 16 equally spaced yaws, retaining the best objective. Rubix-B optimizes the complete anchored bijection. These variants separate optimization from partial matching, except that lattice Rubix-B also changes neighborhood extraction.

blocks.en: F.9.2 Failure Diagnostic and Example Selection
blocks.zh: F.9.2 失败诊断和示例选择

blocks.en: Each GW method restarts at its selected setting with mass 1 / n 0 1/n_{0} per true pair; partial GW rescales to its prescribed mass, never above the true mass at selected settings. A solver failure requires successful rotation recovery with an objective more than a relative 10 − 6 10^{-6} below the failed run. Otherwise, the label “objective failure” means no witness was found, not that a nonconvex GW optimum was established. AM has a solver failure when Rubix closes its gap at the same penalty and recovers the rotation. Both Rubix variants attain costs no greater than the true matching at the true rotation, so their misses are objective failures.
blocks.zh: 每个GW方法在其选定的设定中以每对正对质量为1/n 1/n_{0}重启;部分GW调整为所指定的质量,从不高于所选设置的真实质量. 解答失败需要成功回旋,目标大于失败运行下方的相对 10 - 6 10 - 6 }. 否则,“客观失败”的标签意味着没有找到任何证人,而不是证明确定了一个非曲线的GW最佳。 AM在Rubix以同罚收尾并取回自转时有解析器故障. Rubix两个变体的成本都不超过真正的旋转时的真实匹配,所以它们的缺失是客观的失败.

blocks.en: The median rotation error rises from 0.051 ∘ 0.051^{\circ} with the exact gravity direction to 0.699 ∘ 0.699^{\circ} and 1.369 ∘ 1.369^{\circ} at tilts of 0.5 ∘ 0.5^{\circ} and 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} . Closing the gap of the objective thus solves the constrained problem, but it does not remove the pose error that a biased gravity direction imposes.

blocks.en: G.7 Bound-Cost Policies for Full Rotation
blocks.zh: G.7 全面轮换的带约束性成本政策

blocks.en: Table A.24 compares five SE(3) policies: rotation-cap bounds alone, one-assignment differences, full exterior queries, reused assignment duals and adaptive selection ( Section F.14.3 ). Full exterior queries close the most gaps in the least total time.
blocks.zh: 表A.24比较了五项SE(3)政策:单自旋转-上限界限、一次任务差异、全部外部查询、重复使用的任务双重和适应性选择(F.14.3节)。 完整的外出查询在最少的总时间内关闭了最大的缺口.

blocks.en: Table A.24: Complete SE(3) alignment on 72 scenes with the same host. Each run has a limit of 15 s and a target of 10 − 5 10^{-5} for the gap in the mean squared error. The CPU time is summed over all runs, including the unresolved ones; every policy uses one core. Bold marks more closed gaps or less CPU time than the host with its rotation-cap bounds alone.
blocks.zh: 表A.24:72场景与同台主机完全SE(3)对接. 每次跑有15 s 的极限,目标为 10 - 5 10 - 5 = 平均平方误差的间隔. CPU时间被概括到所有运行中,包括尚未解决的运行中;每个政策都使用一个核心. 粗体标记的闭合缺口或更少的CPU时间比主机单自转-顶盖边框的要多.

blocks.en: Full queries mainly help host timeouts. On 27 high-noise common successes, median host/full-query time ratio is 0.92 0.92 ; a separate low-noise comparison gives 0.76 0.76 . At low noise, adaptation is 1.17 1.17 times faster than full queries but closes fewer gaps.
blocks.zh: 全部查询主要帮助主机超时. 在27个高噪音常见的成功中,中位主机/全平时比为0.92 0.92;单独的低噪音比较给出了0.76 0.76. 在低噪声下,适应速度比全部查询快1.17倍,但缩小了差距.
